item.title: Persona Vectors: Monitoring and Controlling Character Traits in Language Models

items.note:
Memory Card

English

Takeaway A trait direction can track changes induced by prompts and fine-tuning.

Background The authors ask how to measure and control unexpected shifts in assistant character.

Method They estimate activation differences for contrasting trait prompts and test projections and interventions during inference and training.

Conclusion The reported directions track trait expression, and steering can mitigate some shifts.

Gap Test whether matching projections are mediated by the same components. Read Sections 3 and 4 for the two measurement settings.

简体中文

核心要点 同一个特质方向可以追踪提示或微调诱导的变化。

研究背景 作者研究如何测量和控制意外的人格变化。

方法 通过对照特质提示估计激活差，再在推理与训练中检验向量投影及干预。

结论 论文报告这些方向能追踪特质表达，引导干预可缓解部分变化。

研究潜力 可检验相似的投影变化是否由相同组件介导。第 3、4 节分别介绍两种测量设置。

item.title: When Role-playing, Do Models Believe What They Say?

items.note:
Memory Card

English

Takeaway Persona induction can shift expression and internal truth representations by different amounts.

Background The study asks whether induced personas change what models express or what they represent as true.

Method It compares several induction methods with behavioral challenges and probes of internal truth representations.

Conclusion The degree of internalization varies by method in the reported experiments.

Gap Measure expression, defense under challenge and reliance in a later task separately.

简体中文

核心要点 人格诱导对外显表达与内部真值表征的影响可以不同。

研究背景 研究考察诱导人格改变的是模型表达的内容，还是模型表征为真的内容。

方法 作者比较多种诱导方法，并用行为挑战和内部真值探针进行评估。

结论 在报告的实验中，不同方法的内化程度不同。

研究潜力 分别测量表达、遭质疑后的捍卫行为，以及后续任务是否依赖该说法。

collection_note:
Idea Card

English

Research Question When prompting and fine-tuning move the same persona direction, do they use the same causal mechanism?

Design Match behavior and projection shifts across conditions, then compare interventions on the candidate components.

Next Decision Choose a model family and one trait with a measurable behavioral outcome.

简体中文

研究问题 当提示和微调让同一个人格方向发生偏移时，两者是否使用相同的因果机制？

设计 匹配两种条件下的行为与投影变化，再比较干预候选组件后的结果。

下一步 选定一个模型家族与一个能客观测量的特质。
